actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Revise the complete FIRST reference sheet with ONE small component-continuity correction. Preserve its successful opaque sheaths, visible thick mouths, rounded closed caps, empty IVORY case on the right, rear-waist body, plain black pants belt, direct clips, pockets, gloves and thigh equipment.

The dagger GUARDS have been accidentally replaced by the generic sheath rims. Restore the exact TWO DIFFERENT guards from reference2 as separate exposed components ABOVE the existing sheath mouths:
- DARK on the character's RIGHT (viewer RIGHT), and DARK in the isolated detail: restore its original short asymmetric angular lip guard, with the distinct low projecting corner and angled opposing side. Keep its polygonal hard grip, one red ferrule and dark orange-marked pommel.
- IVORY on the character's LEFT (viewer LEFT): restore its original clearly curved ivory/charcoal crescent guard with swept ends. Keep the smooth ivory-inlaid dark grip, single red ferrule and ivory teardrop/orange-dot pommel.
Rotate these same reference guards naturally with the tip-down seated daggers. Do not flatten either into a round collar.

The clearly readable physical sequence must be:
exposed grip -> ONE red ferrule -> the distinct dagger GUARD -> a separate thin visible sheath-mouth rim -> the opaque case.
Each guard rests on top of the rim and extends visibly past it at the sides. The red ferrule must NOT sink directly into the sheath opening. The guard and mouth are two different visible pieces, not one merged ring. Blade stays completely hidden inside the case; no naked silver cutting line or sharp tip returns.

The isolated IVORY case at the far right remains EMPTY with its black open cavity. Do NOT add an ivory hilt or guard to that empty case. Its existing mouth, curved matte shell and blunt cap remain unchanged in design.

Change no other design: anatomical right dark/left ivory, only a single black belt in red pants loops, no upper straps/hooks/chains; preserve current body and established sheath sizes/placement. Do not alter the cases' angular versus curved shapes or introduce new mechanical pieces. Full coherent image-tool redraw, same white layout and labels. Clean hand-drawn anime cel shading, no extra texture, random white dots, cloudy patina or photoreal glare.

reference_inputs.role: Carry v2 accepted visual work on opaque cases/empty mouth/pure belt/clothing; guards had merged into mouth rims and are not authoritative.
Accepted original heterogeneous dagger guard/grip/pommel identities; restore exposed guards only with blade still enclosed.

reference_basis: Actual ordered references preserve the preceding carry composition and opaque case construction while correcting its rejected guard/mouth conflation using the accepted heterogeneous dagger source. A failed reference is not an accepted deliverable.
method: built-in image_gen.imagegen complete-image generation; byte-exact PNG copy and lossless WebP only
